changeset-claim-re-read

## ⚠️ 7 pending changeset(s) describe a file this change touches

Their bodies publish **verbatim** into the CHANGELOG at the next release, so this is a request to **re-read them against your diff** — addressed here because you are the one seat that can answer it without re-deriving anything.

⛔ Nothing here blocks, and nothing here is a verdict on your change. This gate exits 0, is not a required context, and judges **name resolution, never meaning**: it asked whether a pending body names a file you touched. "Is this sentence still true?" is the one question it will not answer, and the one you are being asked to answer.

### `.changeset/7070-no-invented-gantt-date-fields.md`

- names `plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` → `packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` — edited by this change

  > - `app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.tsx` — the console object page. The inline branch becomes `ganttViewOptions`, the sibling of `calendarViewOptions` and `timelineViewOptions`: the declared block spread whole, title floored at `'name'`, no date field invented. - `plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` — the render branch AND the capability gate. - `plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx` — `generateViewSchema`, the authored `object-view` element route, which bypasses `ListView` entirely.

### `.changeset/7499-gantt-non-axis-floors-omitted.md`

- names `plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` → `packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` — edited by this change

  > - `plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` — the `object-gantt` render branch. - `plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx` — `generateViewSchema`, the authored `object-view` element route, which bypasses `ListView` entirely.

### `.changeset/7773-kanban-adapter-groupfield-write.md`

- names `ListView.tsx` → `packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` — edited by this change

  > **Who is NOT affected — the boundary is node-local.** Every VIEW-LEVEL `groupField` read is untouched and still live: it is a legacy alias of the spec's `groupByField` on the kanban *view config*, mapped by `normalize-list-view.ts`, and both adapters still resolve lanes through it (`ObjectView.tsx`'s `kanbanCfg.groupField ||`, `ListView.tsx`'s `groupByField || groupField`). Authoring `options.kanban.groupField` on a `list-view` or `object-view` keeps working exactly as documented in `packages/plugin-list/README.md`. `groupField` is dead only on the generated `object-kanban` NODE.

### `.changeset/7780-object-kanban-record-source.md`

- names `ListView.tsx` → `packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` — edited by this change

  > **`groupBy` is untouched and stays REQUIRED** (objectui#7322, PR #7774). A record source and a lane key are different questions: every lane-less document above is still refused at `groupBy`, and the two readings PR #7774 excluded from counting as a lane-less mode — the `dataSource` json fragment in `content/docs/utilities/data-objectstack.mdx` and `ListView.tsx`'s runtime-generated node — are asserted still-refused in the new pin. The retired `groupField` tombstone is likewise still refused by name.

### `.changeset/8990-object-kanban-groupby-optional.md`

- names `packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` → `packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` — edited by this change

  > - `packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` **generates** the node as `groupBy: laneField`. `objectDef` loads asynchronously, so `laneField` is `undefined` on every load until it lands, and stays `undefined` whenever the object offers no `stageField` hint and none of `status` / `stage` / `state` / `phase`. The renderer serves that node; both published faces refused it. - `content/docs/utilities/data-objectstack.mdx` documents an `object-kanban` node that is exactly `{ type, dataSource }`, with no `groupBy`. ⚠️ This one is weaker and is cited for what it is: that fragment is **still** refused after this change, at `RECORD_SOURCE_REQUIRED`, because `dataSource` is not a rung of the record-source ladder. It shows a lane-less board is a documented authoring; it is not a document this change admits.

### `.changeset/list-user-actions-collision-5398.md`

- names `ListView.tsx` → `packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` — edited by this change

  > The harvest now reads the object block only. Both `userActions` read sites in `ListView.tsx` carry a comment naming the collision, and `__tests__/ListView.userActionsCollision.test.tsx` pins each clause of it: the two shapes, a producer that manufactures the view one, the harvest's blindness to it, and the projection that must keep the object's operand with a toolbar block — or an empty block — present on the view.

### `.changeset/listview-comment-pair-4559.md`

- names `ListView.tsx` → `packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` — edited by this change

  > Two comment corrections in `ListView.tsx` (objectui#4559, objectui#4966). No runtime behaviour changes and the emitted bundle is byte-identical; the published `.d.ts` does change, which is why this is a `patch` rather than an empty frontmatter.

Read the **paragraph**, not the line: both false halves of the objectui#8617 claim sat in one paragraph, and correcting either alone would have left it asserting the same wrong thing.

If a claim did go false, **correct the body**. That is precedented and prose-only, frontmatter untouched; `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` will report the correction as its own case 2 ("correcting a declaration on purpose … legitimate"), which is the intended shape — one gate asks for the read, the other records the write.

Not covered, stated so nobody reads this as more: a born-false claim that spells no line address at all (objectui#9495 coordinated one by ORDINAL — "a grep finds that member first" — and deciding that means reading what the sentence means), a claim spelled as a symbol or a package rather than a backticked file name, and a file named ambiguously.

Compared the checked-out tree with `402a266c9` (merge-base with origin/main): 5 file(s) changed outside `.changeset/`, read against 1481 pending declaration(s) that publish a body (2065 pending in total). · [run](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/actions/runs/36136111654)

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `f0930bbb64db7594d8cc2d966cd4facf64cfd390`

Reviewed from git only: `refs/review/pr-10627` (head `f0930bb`) against merge-base `b1030c71a617c4507e5d220319b728ebf367baf1`; `refs/review/main` at `ac2d6f1`. Spec symbols measured on an installed `@objectstack/spec@17.4.0` (the shared tree at `/home/user/objectui` carries no `node_modules`; the copy under `objectui-issue-10580/node_modules/.pnpm/@objectstack+spec@17.4.0_…` was read, not touched, with a probe script run from this scratch directory). Six files in the PR: one changeset, `ListView.tsx`, `UserFilters.tsx`, three new pins. No existing test is edited or deleted.

### ① Derived judgments

**Card objectui#10545 (chain head), commit `0814660`.** Binding triage `5831112408`: 「read the declared `displayField` (spec first, objectui AGENTS.md 0.1), ⛔ with no fallback to the refused spellings; prefer the reader `plugin-grid` converged on (`relationalMetaKeys.ts`). Say what the sibling `idField` read becomes.」

1. `packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx:3742` — the `objectDef.fields` candidate now reads `displayField: field.displayField` and nothing else (base read `field.display_field || field.reference_field`). RIGHT. Measured on 17.4.0: `FieldSchema.safeParse` of a lookup def accepts `displayField`; refuses `display_field` (`unrecognized_keys`, hint to `displayField`), `reference_field` (hint to `referenceVia`), `id_field` and `idField` (no hint), with the bare def and `zzz_not_a_real_key` as lit controls. No fallback remains, as the triage ordered. The bag is the object-schema def: `objectDef` is set from `dataSource.getObjectSchema(schema.objectName)` at `ListView.tsx:1880-1882`.
2. `packages/plugin-list/src/UserFilters.tsx:311` — `resolveFields` reads `displayField = fieldDef.displayField` alone (base `fieldDef.display_field ?? fieldDef.reference_field`). RIGHT, same contract; `ListView` passes its `objectDef` at `ListView.tsx:4224-4226`.
3. "Prefer the reader `plugin-grid` converged on": `plugin-grid/src/relationalMetaKeys.ts:331` grades `displayField` `spec` as the only display spelling the copy set reads; `reference_field` is `no-producer` (`:328`) and never copied. `plugin-list` does not depend on `plugin-grid` (its `package.json` names no `plugin-grid`), and `applyRelationalMeta` copies the `reference`/`reference_to` pair rather than the candidate's `referenceTo`, so the dev converged on the SAME single spelling instead of importing the function. Judged as satisfying the triage's "prefer": no third spelling was introduced.
4. The sibling `idField` read: REMOVED, not re-pointed. `ListView.tsx:3665` (candidate type has no `idField`), `UserFilters.tsx:39-49` (`ResolvedField` has no `idField`), `:372` (return), `:600-606` (the `field` handed to `LookupValuePicker` carries no `idField`). Judged against the spec: `FieldSchema` refuses both `id_field` and `idField` (measured), so there is no declared spelling to re-point to, and the tree's other two object-def sites say the same (`app-shell/src/utils/resolveActionParams.ts:327-333`, `plugin-charts/src/ObjectChart.tsx:332-338`: `idField` "is NOT a leg this read may gain"). Against consumers: the only consumer is `components/src/custom/filter-builder.tsx:2073` `field.idField || "id"`, `:2098` `r?.[idField] ?? r?.id ?? r?._id`, `:2145` `$filter: { [idField]: … }`; `FilterBuilder`'s `fields` type keeps `idField` optional (`:76`), so dropping it is type-safe. In-repo producers of `id_field` on an object def: none outside tests (the only non-test hits are the two KEEP readers and prose); every `idField:` producer in the tree sits on an action-param, inline-grid-column or widget contract, not on `objectDef.fields`. Behaviour lost for a real consumer: only a stored pre-strict document (served verbatim, left on the def by the choke point with a dev-mode `no-declared-twin` warning, `core/src/utils/reference-keys.ts:366-376`) or a host `DataSource` that hand-feeds `id_field`; for those the picker now keys by `id` instead of that column. That flip is declared in the changeset (lines 27-31). The removal is consistent with the reader the triage told the dev to prefer: the grid's copy set copies no id column (`idField` is `widget-contract`, readers `LOOKUP_EDITOR_ONLY`, `relationalMetaKeys.ts:352`), and since objectui#7155/#7641 the form/grid widget reads `idField` camel only, so a stored `id_field` already reached no reader on that path. RIGHT, with one recorded tension: the objectui#7642 PM ruling (`5542090184`) made "an ingestion choke point canonicalises the alias first" the standing test for a consumer-side retirement, and `id_field` cannot be canonicalised (no declared twin, `reference-keys.ts:130-133`, `:164-173`); the disposition here therefore rests on the later, card-specific triage (which left the choice to the claimer and asked it to be stated) plus AGENTS.md #0.1, not on #7642's test. It also leaves `id_field` split 2/2 across the four object-def readers (`ObjectChart.tsx:339` and `resolveActionParams.ts:676` still read it). Not a defect of this PR; worth its own card (the PR body files no carrier for it).
5. Wider than the claim's "the lookup field-def read only": the `idField` thread through `ResolvedField`, the return object and the `LookupValuePicker` prop. All in the two claimed files, all dead once the `id_field` read went, stated in the PR body. Not asked, explained, harmless.
6. The objectui#7642 census KEEP comments at both sites are replaced (`ListView.tsx:3725-3741`, `UserFilters.tsx:297-310`). Each sentence checked: `objectDef` is the `getObjectSchema` def — true; `FieldSchema` declares `displayField` and refuses the two snake spellings with the stated hints — true (measured); "the single spelling `plugin-grid`'s copy set reads (`RELATIONAL_META_READ_SET`, objectui#7155)" — true (the copy set is derived from that table; `displayField` is its only display entry); "supersedes the objectui#7642 census KEEP, which held only while this chain had no `displayField` leg" — a fair reading of the KEEP's ground ("no camel leg here, so retiring these reads deletes the only read"), the serve-path half of that ground being answered by the next sentence; "A stored pre-strict `display_field` is folded onto `displayField` once, at ingestion (`normalizeSchemaReferenceKeys`, objectui#7650), never here" — true: `data-objectstack/src/index.ts:4865` calls it inside `getObjectSchema`, `canonicalizeRetiredFieldKeys` (`reference-keys.ts:334-399`) folds by alias probe (lowercase, strip `_`/`-`/space), and `display_field` probes onto declared `displayField`; "`FieldSchema` declares none [id column] for a lookup (it refuses `idField` and `id_field` alike)" — true; "`plugin-grid`'s copy set copies no id column" — true. `UserFilters.tsx:301-303` "a host's `objectDef` is held to the same contract (AGENTS.md #0.1)" — a policy statement consistent with #0.1. The replacement comments read true.
7. Nothing asked is missing: declared read, no fallback, `idField` disposition stated, pins beside the existing tests, one changeset.

**Card objectui#10547 (member), commit `61ce977`.** Binding triage `5831160366`, reusing ruling `5809501335` on objectui#7531 (letter remove): 「drop the `options` read so select options come from the object definition once it loads.」
